Team Leadership & Delivery. Lead a team of developers across frontend, backend, and integration layers. Provide technical mentoring, coaching. Job Title. Specialist, Systems Engineering. What does a successful DevOps Engineer do at Fiserv? As a DevOps Engineer, you will be a key player in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of our globally distributed, high-availability payment gateway platform. This mission-critical system operates 24/7 across multiple regions, processing millions of transactions daily. You will work closely with operations, and security teams to automate infrastructure, optimize CI/CD pipelines, and implement robust monitoring and incident response strategies. Work closely with our DevOps Engineers and our agile development teams to continuously improve and automate our software development process and runtime environments. Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for rapid and reliable deployments. Enhance solutions reliably through Configuration as Code and GitOps as part of an international team. Train, mentor, and guide junior DevOps engineers to build skills. Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback. Lead by example and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the team. Communicate effectively across teams and time zones. What will you do. BE/BTech, ME/MTech in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience. Extensive experience in DevOps practices and methodologies. 5+ years in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering roles, ideally supporting high-availability, distributed systems. Deep knowledge of AWS cloud platforms with hands-on experience in infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). Proven experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI. Strong skills in Kubernetes and Helm. Advanced Programming Skills for Automation. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You should be able to work independently and multitask effectively, drive yourself and other towards task completion. Apply GenAI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, and analysis. Leverage ML, NLP, or AI automation to optimize workflows, testing, data analysis, or product development. What you need to have. Experience in ML/AI or software engineering with hands-on deep learning projects delivered to production. Strong Python skills and practical experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow. Proven experience with Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and operating ML services. Experience with MLflow or comparable experiment tracking and model registry solutions. Experience deploying ML workloads on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP). Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, etc.). Strong software engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, modular design and documentation. Clear communication skills and experience working cross-functionally in regulated environments. Collaborate with cross functional teams to integrate AI models, automation pipelines, or intelligent assistants into products. What would be great to have. You have worked before in an agile development environment, and you are familiar with the PI Planning process and to are able to understand how to align the development to deliver effective towards a PI and Release . You have experience in working with a multi-locational matrix organization where technology teams and delivery is done across multiple teams and locations. Develop scalable applications using Java / .NET / Python / React / Cloud, enhanced with AI‑assisted development. Prior work in payments, banking or regulated fintech with emphasis on auditability, privacy and security. Ensure ethical AI usage, data governance compliance, and secure handling of model outputs. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies and recommend adoption strategies. Experience with AI APIs (OpenAI, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock) is a plus. jobDescription: Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv. We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. Job Title. Specialist, Solutions Architecture (Kubernetes Engineer). Job Posting Title : Specialist, Solutions Architecture (Kubernetes). Experience - 3 to 7 Years. Work Location - Noida, Pune or Bangalore . Mandatory Skills : Kubernetes, GCP/AWS, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD. Join the Fintech & POS Revolution. At Clover, we're on a mission to help small businesses grow faster by delivering the technology and insights that were previously only available to larger enterprises. As part of the Fiserv family, a global leader in Fintech and payments, you’ll be part of a fast-paced, entrepreneurial team delivering innovative financial services experiences that align with the way people live and work today. Clover delivers the leading Point of Sale (POS) system, combining elegant hardware, cloud-based software, payments processing, APIs for third-party developers, and an ecosystem of over 220 apps. Our platform serves millions of transactions daily, powering businesses from small merchants to large-scale operations like football stadiums. If you're passionate about distributed, scalable and secure technology and want to make a lasting impact on millions of merchants’ lives, we want you to be part of the team! What does a Solution Architect(Kubernetes) do? Cloud Platform team builds the Kubernetes based microservice platform that application teams rely on to operate their critical services. You will design and build large scale, fault tolerant, distributed systems that will enable Clover engineering to ship features quickly and safely to our customers. You will play a key role in developing the team’s technical strategic roadmap, and will collaborate with service development teams to design, build and support the platform. Working frequently with other teams, you will coordinate major changes to cross-system architectures, and have an influential impact on their work. If you have extensive experience with building and managing Kubernetes ecosystems and other cloud native technology, a systematic problem-solving approach, strong communications skills and a sense of ownership – we want to hear from you! In this role, you will. Design and implement our cloud-based service platform. Make architectural decisions around our use of Kubernetes and the surrounding ecosystem. Work with developers who utilize the platform and incorporate their feedback to evolve it. Help your teammates grow through better processes, practices and technical guidance. Scale systems sustainably through automation and contribute changes that improve reliability and velocity. Evaluate and implement new technological solutions through proof of concept and drive to completion. Be part of a recurring production support on call rotation. Conduct blameless postmortems for incidents and diligently follow through with remediations. On this team, you will manage large scale and demanding infrastructure needs. Cloud Platform is at the center of core infrastructure, your impact will be felt by the entire Clover organization. Basic qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of industry experience. Production experience with Kubernetes, service meshes, and the tooling in that ecosystem (Helm, CI/CD, Terraform, etc). Experience building, deploying and maintaining large scale platforms. Aptitude for diagnosing technical issues, debugging and automating routine tasks. A fundamental understanding of networking (Loadbalancers, Kubernetes networking, VPCs, mTLS, etc). Experience with major cloud providers such as AWS, GCP or Azure. Knowledge of observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Grafana. Experience working with various database technologies. Preferred qualifications. Proficiency in a modern programming languages (e.g., Java, Go, Python, Ruby, or similar). Knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, and parallel processing. Familiarity with various technologies: Application APIs - OpenAPI, Protobuf, GraphQL,. Proxy - Nginx, HAProxy, Envoy, Apache Server. Caching - Redis, Memcache.
